g.text: Team: custom roles on, no lineup applied yet. Enter to change.
A role names the model for one job; it fires whenever that job runs (a sub-agent's bio or the active
lineup names it). With roles off, every job uses the default model.
Lineups -- which roles exist and which model each uses
Enter choose | Ctrl+N new | Ctrl+E edit | Ctrl+S save | Esc back
